channel.title: Latest Job Vacancies at Djinni
channel.description: Stay updated with the newest job opportunities at Djinni.

item.title: Python Developer
item.description:
We are looking for an experienced Python Developer to join a made-up project as soon as possible.

 

Requirements

  • Habit of writing small pull requests with clear descriptions
  • Good command of one mainstream language and its testing tools
  • Experience with containers and a major cloud provider
  • Several years of professional experience building backend services

  • Availability to start ASAP

     

Nice to Have

  • Paid time off above the legal minimum
  • Learning budget for books and courses
  • Equal opportunity: we welcome people of every background

item.title: Middle Python Engineer
item.description:
You will work with product managers and designers to turn rough ideas into small, testable steps. You will improve observability: structured logs, metrics and traces that answer real questions. You will own the quality of your changes from the first commit to the production dashboard.

 

Must have

  • Experience with containers and a major cloud provider
  • Experience with relational databases, migrations and query tuning
  • Fluent written and spoken English

item.title: Strong Junior/ Middle AI Engineer
item.description:
You will improve observability: structured logs, metrics and traces that answer real questions. You will design, build and run services that handle bookings, payments and notifications. You will take part in on-call rotations and help the team keep alerts quiet and useful.

 

Must have

  • Willingness to learn the domain and ask questions early
  • Experience with relational databases, migrations and query tuning
  • Fluent written and spoken English

item.title: Senior Python Backend Engineer
item.description:
You will design, build and run services that handle bookings, payments and notifications. You will help migrate older modules to the new platform without downtime. You will write documentation that a new colleague can follow on the first day.

 

Must have

  • Good command of one mainstream language and its testing tools
  • Experience with containers and a major cloud provider
  • Experience with relational databases, migrations and query tuning

 

This is a remote position based in Ukraine. Candidates must have full professional proficiency in English.
